content.text:
Name parsing already belongs to `FunderNameFeatures` in [funder_name.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.improve-individual-donor-parsing/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/funder_name.rs:20).

- `from_name` preserves original spelling in `name_raw`, normalizes names, extracts parenthetical evidence, and produces person and organisation features.
- `person_core` already removes leading `mr`, `mrs`, `lord`, `dame`, and other titles, but discards the separated titles. Its private string list is at [line 181](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.improve-individual-donor-parsing/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/funder_name.rs:181).
- Tokenization already makes `Lord (Michael) Farmer` become `lord michael farmer`, with `person_core = michael farmer`. However, `name_normalized` retains parentheses and lowercase spelling. There is no person display-name representation preserving `Lord Michael Farmer`.
- Parenthetical extraction is deliberately general. Organisation examples such as `BJD (GB) Limited` preserve geographic information, and aliases and acronyms use parentheses. Avoid globally removing parenthetical text.

Smallest owning change is to split person parsing into typed title components and the remaining name in this same domain module, using one canonical title enum. Derive `person_core` and initials from that result. Add the desired title-preserving person representation there, with narrowly scoped parentheses handling for a leading title followed by a parenthesized given name. Preserve raw evidence.

Consumers need explicit attention. Cleaning embeds these features with `serde(flatten)` at [declaration_cleaning.rs:342](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.improve-individual-donor-parsing/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declaration_cleaning.rs:342); Parquet columns are declared separately at [outbound/declaration_cleaning.rs:288](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.improve-individual-donor-parsing/exposed/src/lib/outbound/declaration_cleaning.rs:288). Any added serialized fields require corresponding schema columns and documentation in `docs/declaration-cleaning.md`.

Resolution currently ignores person features. Its [Observation](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.improve-individual-donor-parsing/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declaration_resolution/input.rs:12) reads raw and normalized names, organisation core, and aliases. Exact donor linking compares `name_normalized` at [identity.rs:79](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.improve-individual-donor-parsing/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/declaration_resolution/identity.rs:79). Adding person components alone will not merge parenthesized and unparenthesized donor spellings.

Existing unit tests in [funder_name/tests.rs](/Users/jamie/development/exposed.improve-individual-donor-parsing/exposed/src/lib/domain/models/funder_name/tests.rs:1) cover `Mr.`, Sir, Lord, raw preservation, geographic parentheses, acronyms, aliases, and withheld names. Add Mrs/Dame, case and dotted titles, `Lord (Michael) Farmer`, untitled names, and negative organisation-parentheses cases alongside them.
